rationale.complete: Rounds 1 and 2 done. Round 1: replication on 33 kickoffs plus four natives, synthetic first. Round 2 (R5, R3, R1, R2; pre-registered and committed before any round-2 statistic, synthetic S6-S8 and Amendment R2-1 before the real runs): embedding swap for P1, G51 and NE38; per-agent read-out re-quench with a read vs in-flight contrast; #12 debates and #19/#21 two-option natives; first-plan read test. Not done: R4 (needs paid labels), R6, holdout.
rationale.faithfulness: The core claim now holds in both embedding models (top-1 18/33 and 20/33; #51 0.95/0.96; NE38 +0.61/+0.56). Round 2 adds a partition-contrast result: human messages pull readers beyond unread in-flight messages at matched lag (C +0.11/+0.12), with in-flight carrying 40-50% (convergence). Agent plans fail as targets (reversed), two domains fail in every design, P3 failed, P2 mixed, and several round-1 secondaries (room-centroid P4, G38, agent susceptibility) are model-dependent. Holdout not run. Scorecard A1 B1 C2 D1 E1 F2 G2 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: A design rule with interventions behind it, now model-robust: day-1 content lands on what the kickoff names; private goals pin agents; a reassignment moves an agent within a day. Round 2 adds operator timing: a human message moves its readers at their next message, the pull fades within ~10 min, and agent plans or two offered tasks do not steer or split the swarm.

one_line: Day-1 content lands on its kickoff in both embedding models (top-1 18/33, 20/33); #51 agents on private goals (0.95); human messages pull readers beyond unread convergence (+0.11); agent plans do not.
